about: The Workbench icons of the FreeSiege drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/freesiege.png) is upstream's freesiege.png (64 x 64) doubled to 128 x 128, under the game's own terms. FreeSiege-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, FreeSiege.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's FreeSiege.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for Controls, Authors.txt and the licences; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
